name: GLIMAT
description: Validates glacier and ice sheet model output (NetCDF) against geomorphological data: ice extent overlap, ice margins, flow lineations and point measurements. A port of the GLIMAT QGIS plugin by Yingkui Li.
author: Yingkui Li (GLIMAT); RustGIS port by giswqs

tools.name: Polygon Overlap (APOA)
tools.summary: Compares modelled ice extent with a mapped ice extent polygon at each time step: F1-score, IoU, precision and recall.

params.name: model
params.label: Model output (NetCDF path)
params.help: The model output file, such as a PISM run. It's read in place, so it can be any size.

params.name: crs
params.label: Model coordinate system
params.help: EPSG code or WKT of the model grid. Leave empty to read it from the NetCDF.

tools.name: Flow Direction (AFDA)
tools.summary: Compares the modelled ice flow direction with mapped flow lineations at each time step: mean angular difference, vector strength, and the shares of normal, frozen-bed and ice-free cells.

params.name: model
params.label: Model output (NetCDF path)
params.help: The model output file, such as a PISM run. It's read in place, so it can be any size.

params.name: lineations
params.label: Flow lineations
params.help: Lines drawn in the direction of ice flow, from start to end.

params.name: crs
params.label: Model coordinate system
params.help: EPSG code or WKT of the model grid. Leave empty to read it from the NetCDF.

params.name: ice_threshold
params.label: Ice threshold
params.help: Cells whose ice variable is at least this have ice (thickness or fraction).

params.name: velocity_threshold
params.label: Velocity threshold (m/a)
params.help: Ice slower than this is treated as a frozen bed.
